summary: Network socket object constructor (thiscall, returns this). Validates and copies a 0x30-byte source configuration block into the object, installs two vtables (off_5B8B3C at this+0x940, off_5B8A68 at this+0), zero-initialises five async socket slot blocks, creates a mutex per slot (five Win32MutexCreateRecreate calls plus one MutexCreateRecreate), initialises socket addresses and sub-objects (sub_5824F0/sub_582720/sub_5828B0/sub_581D40/sub_581FD0), records this as the global serialization header (dword_8D3E24) and hands the finished object to sub_57E480. Called by NetworkSocketObjectCreate (0057A420).

local_names.this: the network socket object being constructed
local_names.a3: additional configuration argument passed through to sub_5837F0
